stages.next_action: Preserve A0 as passed; all later source work remains offline and checksummed.
stages.objective: Freeze the research-only mandate, capital and risk boundary, stage graph, durable handoff and fail-closed validator.
stages.pass_gate: Contracts are canonical, unsafe runtime assumptions fail closed, no instrument or strategy is approved, and actionable output remains no_trade.

stages.next_action: Freeze a bounded OANDA hourly bid/ask intraday pilot for FX, spot metal and index CFDs; do not use oil or bond CFDs until historical continuous financing is qualified.
stages.objective: Qualify an account-specific OANDA broker-native research universe with immutable bid/ask data, causal timestamps, segments and cost semantics without relabelling CFDs as futures.
stages.pass_gate: The selected development instruments pass hourly source, identity, timestamp, gap, bid/ask and intraday cost gates; all positions are flat before daily financing and no execution instrument is approved.

stages.next_action: Record independent acceptance or rejection before selecting a non-trend family.
stages.objective: Evaluate one frozen intraday multi-market trend family at fixed risk using chronological and genuinely prospective evidence.
stages.pass_gate: The trend family beats flat, matched-exposure and simple controls after historical bid/ask and frozen slippage with acceptable uncertainty, concentration and drawdown; multiple speeds remain one family.

stages.next_action: Continue to risk overlays only if at least one arm passes; routing still requires two distinct accepted families.
stages.objective: Evaluate one economically distinct non-trend intraday family selected before results.
stages.pass_gate: The chosen family independently passes causal, cost, capacity, robustness, attribution and unseen-evidence gates; no alternative opens after observing PnL.

stages.next_action: Retain the simple risk benchmark regardless of result; do not create a universal directional regime oracle.
stages.objective: Evaluate continuous volatility, correlation and liquidity risk scaling for accepted arms, beginning with simple EWMA and covariance controls.
stages.pass_gate: Risk scaling improves frozen tail and risk-adjusted metrics without changing forecast direction, exceeding leverage limits or depending on hindsight thresholds.

stages.next_action: Freeze the complete shared-capital system before prospective observation.
stages.objective: Compare no_trade, the best single arm, a static accepted-arm blend and a deterministic risk-aware router using one shared capital account.
stages.pass_gate: At least two economically distinct arms are accepted and routing adds stable net value after costs, uncertainty, turnover and concentration while actionable output remains no_trade.

stages.next_action: Require a new execution mandate, exact venue, credentials review and explicit written approval before any live-capital proposal.
stages.objective: Prospectively paper-observe each accepted arm and the shared-capital portfolio with availability, forecasts, fills, costs, risk and decay attribution.
stages.pass_gate: The frozen observer completes its predeclared duration and opportunity minimums without evidence contamination, unresolved operational failures or drawdown-limit breaches.
